sections.bio:
Most B2B startups don’t have a lead problem.
 
They have a consistency problem.
 
Some weeks your pipeline looks full.
Other weeks, it’s completely dry.
 
Sales slow down.
Marketing feels like guesswork.
Events don’t bring real ROI.
 
And you?
You get pulled into operations instead of focusing on growth.
 
Now imagine the opposite.
A steady flow of qualified leads coming in every week.
Sales conversations that actually convert.
Events that generate real business, not just impressions.
 
A pipeline that’s predictable.
 
That’s what I help you build.
 
I’ve worked with 50+ startups and tech companies across the UK & Europe, turning scattered efforts into simple, scalable systems that drive revenue.
 
Here’s what that looks like:
 
• 1000+ qualified leads added into pipelines
• Up to 30% improvement in sales conversions
• Stronger marketing visibility and engagement
• Events that create real opportunities
• Access to the right investors and networks
 
No random tactics.
No fluff.
 
Just systems that work.
 
 
You focus on strategy.
 I handle the execution that keeps your pipeline moving.
 
 
If your growth feels inconsistent and you want a predictable way to generate leads and close deals, send me a message.
 
Let’s build systems that scale.

There is no cost to attend. If the workshop leads to any paid offers afterward, a share of the revenue can go back to support the community.

If you'd like to see this workshop happen in your group, reply with a 👍 or tag your group admin, and I'll get in touch to arrange it.

Hi everyone
I help startups, agencies, and B2B companies grow through lead generation, event marketing, sales outreach, and marketing campaigns.

My services include:
• Lead generation and prospect list building
• Event marketing and attendee outreach
• Sales outreach through LinkedIn and email
• Appointment setting
• Investor outreach

I work remotely with businesses across the UK, Europe, and the US.
If you're looking to generate more qualified leads, fill your sales pipeline, promote an event, or scale your outreach, I'd love to connect.

Feel free to send me a message or leave a comment. 

I'm always happy to discuss how I can help your business grow.
